listing.name: Free Cam 2025 0.2.4
listing.summary: Adds a free camera mode with scroll wheel support, fog of war rendering, and a hotkey to cycle through allied ships.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a free camera mode with scroll wheel support, fog of war rendering, and a hotkey to cycle through allied ships.

description:
download:

https://gitlab.com/starsector/free_cam_2025/-/archive/0.2.4/free_cam_2025-0.2.4.zip

previous versions:

https://gitlab.com/starsector/free_cam_2025/-/releases

Safe to add and remove, integrated with lunalib

Features:

Working scroll wheel

Hold button or toggle control scheme

Fog of war for free cam (works by rendering black squares over the battle map)

Hotkey to switch between allied ships.

Most things are customizable with lunalib and the settings file

default key for activation is left alt

default key for ally cam is M

Changelog:

0.2.2

UI scaling now keeps the mouse control centered.

0.2.3

fixed small fog squares with fullscreen with low resolution. Optional as starsector does not always do this

0.2.4

made bug fix automatic, removing the setting

Earlier Changelogs:

Spoiler0.0.1

Initial release

0.0.2

added setting for fog square size

fixed lunalib default options

0.1.0

removed fog color option due to rendering issue. You can still replace the sprite to recolor the fog

added scroll wheel functionality

removed scroll keys due to scroll wheel working

removed use scroll option due to scroll working

added deadzone multiplier for panning the camera

added advanced options, exposing all the constants

changed default activate key to left alt, because tilde key is taken by show weapon arcs.

improved flickering on the fog of war

fixed issue with free cam being controllable when looking at the tactical map

added message that tells you when free cam is enabled and disabled only when hold mode is off

0.1.1

fixed issue where activating free cam in the loading screen would crash

disabled free cam in the main menu

0.1.2

updated to starsector 0.98a

0.2.0

added cycle ally cam, which focuses the free cam on one of your ships, in order when free cam is active. Default key is 'M'

added outside of the map reveled option, which makes it so out of bounds counts as outside of the fog of war rather than inside it.

0.2.1

modules no longer count as ships for ally cam

[close]

aiDescription: Provides a customizable free camera tool that allows players to pan and zoom the battle map using the scroll wheel or a hold/toggle control scheme. It includes a fog of war effect that renders black squares over the map and a dedicated key to switch the camera focus between allied ships. Most settings are adjustable through the integrated lunalib configuration.

changelog.0.2.4: made bug fix automatic, removing the setting
changelog.0.2.3: fixed small fog squares with fullscreen with low resolution. Optional as starsector does not always do this
changelog.0.2.2: UI scaling now keeps the mouse control centered.
